# SnackbarContent

Content for Snackbar component

## Overview

- **Category**: feedback
- **Base Library**: mui
- **MUI Component**: SnackbarContent

## Installation

```bash
npm install @lsy-netline/netline-ui
```

## Import

```typescript
import { SnackbarContent } from '@lsy-netline/netline-ui';
```

## Basic Usage

```tsx
<SnackbarContent
  message="Custom snackbar content"
/>
```

## Examples

```tsx
<SnackbarContent
  message="Custom snackbar content"
/>
```

## MUI Reference

This component is based on Material-UI's SnackbarContent.

For additional props and detailed API documentation, refer to:

- [MUI SnackbarContent Documentation](https://mui.com/material-ui/api/snackbarcontent/)
